svg.title: example’s GitHub constellation
svg.desc: 13 public repositories arranged in a deterministic force layout. Solid lines connect projects through selected languages; detected languages include secondary languages; dotted bridges join nearby groups visually and do not represent dependencies. 12 of 12 shared connections shown. Brighter paths emphasize nearby relationships; faint paths preserve the remaining selected overlaps. Star size reflects GitHub stars. Identity rings are seeded by the account name; ring points provide placement anchors for nodes. lunar-pages, first-light, sky-map, newborn, typed-orbits, active, quiet, dormant, archived, mature, orbital-engine, web-observatory, star-atlas. Outer orbit represents observed public activity over 52 weeks; missing history is unknown. Language rings show inferred creation cohorts, using current language data. Node appearance reflects project age and known maintenance.
svg.text: 52 weeks · observed public events · gaps unknown · Language eras inferred from project creation
Size: legacy · Glow: uniform · Color: language · Links: uniform
